Application.description: An application in the image's application catalog. A healthy image populates these members from the catalog the image was imported with; Enabled and Metadata are the service's own rather than echoes of that catalog.

Enabled.description: Whether the application is enabled. AppStream can disable an application after image creation if there is a problem with it, so a healthy image reports true and this is the one Application member whose value is the service's judgement rather than an echo of the imported catalog.

LaunchParameters.description: The arguments passed to the application at launch.

LaunchPath.description: The path to the application executable in the instance.

Metadata.description: Additional service-defined attributes describing the application. The keys are chosen by AppStream rather than by the caller, so the shape is a string map; a healthy imported image reports WORKING_DIRECTORY.

Tag.description: A key-value pair associated with the image.

schema.description: Resource Type definition for AWS::AppStream::Image (read-only). Represents an existing Amazon AppStream 2.0 private image and supports Read and List, for referencing an image in templates and for inventory, tag and compliance coverage. Importing an image is intentionally out of scope: CreateImportedImage is a long-running asynchronous build over an EC2 AMI the caller must first register with UEFI boot and TPM 2.0 support, which does not fit a CloudFormation stack lifecycle.

Applications.description: The applications associated with the image.

AppstreamAgentVersion.description: The version of the AppStream agent reported for this image.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the image.

CreatedTime.description: The time the image was created.

Description.description: The description displayed for the image.

DisplayName.description: The name displayed for the image.

DynamicAppProvidersEnabled.description: Indicates whether dynamic app providers are enabled within the image.

ImageBuilderSupported.description: Indicates whether an image builder can be launched from this image.

ImageSharedWithOthers.description: Indicates whether the image is shared with another AWS account.

LatestAppstreamAgentVersion.description: Indicates whether the image is using the latest AppStream agent version.

ManagedSoftwareIncluded.description: Indicates whether the image includes license-included applications.

Name.description: The unique name of the image.

Platform.description: The operating system platform of the image.

SupportedInstanceFamilies.description: The instance families that can launch from this image.

Tags.description: The tags associated with the image.

Visibility.description: Indicates whether the image is public, private, or shared.
